luna_triage.reason: The source says the added standard anchoring items enabled a replication of Tversky and Kahneman’s classic procedure, and its reference list establishes the named original. Neither supplied shipped row 1475 nor 1494 is that original: they concern incidental environmental anchoring papers. The retested finding is the classic standard anchoring effect, in which estimates shift toward high versus low numeric anchors.
